title: The Believable Adventures of an Invisible Man

events.response:
You've always been an outsider. At school, being interested in science, the 
other students didn't want to have anything to do with you. The other boys 
laughed at you, the girls despised you. Your parents didn't understand you. And 
even your teachers were so far below your intellectual level that you couldn't 
have a serious conversation with them! This went so far that you always got bad 
grades, although you were smarter than everybody else - your stupid teachers 
simply never saw it.

Now, after years of restless private scientific research, you've finally 
achieved your goal: You've found the secret of invisibility. Everyone at work 
(you don't know any people outside work) said you were mad when you announced 
your plans... especially your boss who just laughed and said a lowly research 
assistant working at a second-rate university would never be able to do it. He 
only hired you to do the most stupid, repetitive and primitive of work, after 
all. Most of the day, you're forced to clean test tubes. Nobody has ever 
recognised your genius! Now you've proven them all wrong - and you'll have your 
revenge on them! Yes, revenge... the only thing you can think of right now. 
Revenge. Revenge! REVENGE!

The Believable Adventures of an Invisible Man
A Reasonably Realistic Revenge Romp by Hannes Schueller
